row00.host_recalculation: Computed the 8 by 8 rational edge determinant independently by exact Gaussian elimination. row00.guard: Compared simplex_valid with FiniteCore.lean:84–93. The proof supplies the same eleven conjuncts using closed row_shape, volume/positivity, gap/mean, weighted means, Jensen and floor facts. Its statement has no hypotheses.
